sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不太喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe 获取特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是娜塔莉·基特罗韦夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As the labor market cools and artificial intelligence booms, many workers are worrying about what their place will be in a changing economy.
sentences.zh: 随着劳动力市场降温和人工智能蓬勃发展，许多工人在不断变化的经济中开始担心自己的位置。

sentences.en: My colleague Karen Wise got her hands on internal strategy documents from Amazon that offer a glimpse into that future.
sentences.zh: 我的同事卡伦·怀斯获得了亚马逊的内部战略文件，这些文件让我们得以窥见那个未来。

sentences.en: In them, she found that the nation's second largest employer plans to replace hundreds of thousands of jobs with robots.
sentences.zh: 在这些文件中，她发现这家全美第二大雇主计划用机器人取代数十万个工作岗位。

sentences.en: Today, Karen walks me through Amazon's ambitious plans and what they could mean for the American workforce.
sentences.zh: 今天，卡伦将带我了解亚马逊雄心勃勃的计划，以及这些计划对美国劳动力的意义。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月3日，星期一。

sentences.en: Karen, you know, as well as anyone, that we have been hearing for a very long time that robots are going to be coming for our jobs, especially at companies like Amazon.
sentences.zh: 卡伦，你比任何人都清楚，我们很长一段时间以来一直听到这样的说法：机器人要来抢我们的饭碗了，特别是在亚马逊这样的公司。

sentences.en: But you've been reporting on how that moment that we've all been anticipating is finally here.
sentences.zh: 但你一直在报道我们所有人都在期待的那个时刻是如何终于来临的。

sentences.en: So tell us what you found.
sentences.zh: 所以，给我们讲讲你发现了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I've been looking into this because covering the company for as long as I've had, I saw this huge growth in their headcount and the number of employees they had.
sentences.zh: 对，我一直在调查这个，因为长期以来我一直在报道这家公司，我看到他们的人数和雇员数量出现了巨大的增长。

sentences.en: And then in the past few years, it started essentially plateauing.
sentences.zh: 然后在过去几年里，这个数字基本上开始趋于平缓。

sentences.en: So you could tell something was starting to happen behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 所以你能看出幕后开始发生一些事情了。

sentences.en: But I didn't realize how much progress they had made until I got my hands on some internal documents.
sentences.zh: 但我直到拿到一些内部文件，才意识到他们取得了多大的进展。

sentences.en: And these are the internal strategy documents for the robotics and automation team.
sentences.zh: 这些是机器人和自动化团队的内部战略文件。

sentences.en: It documents sign-offs at the most senior level of the company.
sentences.zh: 它记录了公司最高层签署批准的情况。

sentences.en: And it really showed the breadth of the ambition that they have, the progress that they see.
sentences.zh: 它确实展现了他们宏大的野心，以及他们所看到的进展。

sentences.en: And what I found in these documents is that they have plans to avoid hiring more than half a million workers because of using robots.
sentences.zh: 我在这些文件中发现，他们计划通过使用机器人来避免雇用超过五十万名工人。

sentences.en: And big picture, their long-term goal is to automate 75% of their operations.
sentences.zh: 从宏观来看，他们的长期目标是实现75%的运营自动化。

sentences.en: That is just remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真是了不起。

sentences.en: Amazon is planning for a world where only a quarter of its operations, you're saying, are done by humans.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，亚马逊正在规划这样一个世界：其运营中只有四分之一是由人类完成的。

sentences.en: And it's a really big deal because Amazon's the second biggest private employer in the country.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件大事，因为亚马逊是美国第二大私营雇主。

sentences.en: And they're also just seen as kind of a leader, a flagship employer in the country that really shapes where jobs are heading.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也被视为该国的某种领导者、旗舰雇主，真正塑造着就业的未来方向。

sentences.en: And so I knew that if they were making this progress, other companies would follow.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，如果他们在取得这样的进展，其他公司也会效仿。

sentences.en: You're saying this matters far beyond Amazon.
sentences.zh: 你是说这不仅仅关乎亚马逊。

sentences.en: Exactly, yeah.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，是的。

sentences.en: They are kind of a signature employer of this kind of hourly workforce.
sentences.zh: 他们可以说是这种按小时计酬的劳动力的标志性雇主。

sentences.en: So it's a really big deal much beyond them.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅关乎他们自身，而是一件影响深远的大事。

sentences.en: How fast will this happen?
sentences.zh: 这会有多快发生？

sentences.en: That's a vision for 2033, but that is only with the advancements they currently have and NOAA.
sentences.zh: 这是对2033年的愿景，但这还只是基于他们目前的技术进步和NOAA。

sentences.en: So there's an expectation that it could even kind of improve over time.
sentences.zh: 因此人们期望随着时间推移甚至可能会有所改进。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're talking about massive change here.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以我们谈论的是这里的巨大变革。

sentences.en: But Karen, we know, right, that Amazon has been automating for a while now.
sentences.zh: 但是卡伦，我们都知道，亚马逊进行自动化已经有一段时间了，对吧？

sentences.en: So what's different about this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么这个时刻有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: They have been automating and using robotics for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 他们进行自动化和使用机器人已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: But what happened is they became this enormous employer.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，他们变成了一个庞大的雇主。

sentences.en: In 2018, they had fewer than 400,000 U.S.
sentences.zh: 在2018年，他们在全美只有不到40万名员工

sentences.en: employees to more than a million in just a couple years.
sentences.zh: 短短几年内就超过了一百万。

sentences.en: So they became so big, it became expensive and hard to keep that many people cycling through their buildings.
sentences.zh: 所以他们变得如此庞大，以至于让这么多人不断在他们的建筑物里流转变得既昂贵又困难。

sentences.en: And so you see a focus now on not augmenting workers, but actually avoiding hiring people so that you are actually ultimately trying to bring down
sentences.zh: 因此，你现在可以看到重点不是去辅助工人，而是实际上避免雇用人员，从而最终努力减少

sentences.en: the total number of people that you have.
sentences.zh: 你所拥有的总人数。

sentences.en: And the other thing that changed is these investments in technology they've been making over the years began clicking.
sentences.zh: 另一个改变是，他们多年来在技术上的这些投资开始发挥作用了。

sentences.en: You know, it takes several years to develop strong robotic systems that actually work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，开发出真正起作用的强大机器人系统需要好几年时间。

sentences.en: And they've reached a point where they feel like these different systems are working, they're working together, and they can begin rolling them out at scale.
sentences.zh: 而他们已经达到了这样一个点：他们觉得这些不同的系统正在发挥作用，它们在协同工作，并且他们可以开始大规模推广了。

sentences.en: And how much does this advancement with the robots have to do with AI?
sentences.zh: 机器人技术的这种进步与人工智能有多大关系？

sentences.en: Like, is AI driving that?
sentences.zh: 比如，人工智能在推动这一进程吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it does have to do with the robots because they are getting more sophisticated and more capable because of AI.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实与机器人有关，因为由于人工智能，它们变得越来越复杂、能力也越来越强。

sentences.en: But it also has to do with the desire to cut costs because Amazon is spending so much money building AI, building data centers, you know, hundreds of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 但这也与削减成本的渴望有关，因为亚马逊在构建人工智能和数据中心上花费了大量资金，你知道的，数千亿美元。

sentences.en: And so they need cash.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要资金。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So you're saying basically what's different now is that Amazon has the capacity, actually, to replace people en masse because this technology has evolved so much,
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，现在基本上不同的地方在于亚马逊实际上有能力大规模取代人类，因为这项技术已经进化了这么多，

sentences.en: partly thanks to AI.
sentences.zh: 部分要归功于人工智能。

sentences.en: And it has the need to do so in a much more urgent way than it ever has before, also partly because of its investment in AI.
sentences.zh: 而且它比以往任何时候都更加迫切地需要这样做，这也部分是因为它在人工智能方面的投资。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So essentially, it now makes more business sense for the company to invest in robots than in hiring more people.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，对公司来说，投资机器人现在比雇用更多人从商业角度来看更加合理了。

sentences.en: It's become cost-effective.
sentences.zh: 这变得具有成本效益了。

sentences.en: That does seem like a moment to Mark.
sentences.zh: 对马克来说，这确实感觉是一个关键节点。

sentences.en: It also seems important just to understand how Amazon got here, how its workforce became so large that it finds itself in this position.
sentences.zh: 理解亚马逊是如何走到这一步的，以及它的劳动力是如何变得如此庞大以至于陷入这种境地的，这也同样重要。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个。

sentences.en: Yeah, so if you go back even to 2012, at the time they had, you know, a handful of warehouses around the country.
sentences.zh: 好的，如果追溯到2012年，当时他们在全国只有寥寥几个仓库。

sentences.en: You know, they started with books, obviously, and moved into CDs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们显然是从书籍开始的，然后进军CD。

sentences.en: And so they had a growing variety of products.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有不断增加的产品种类。

sentences.en: And Amazon, they have this idea that drives everything, that consumers always want things faster, they want them cheaper, and they want bigger selection.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊有一个驱动一切的理念，即消费者总是希望东西更快、更便宜，而且选择更多。

sentences.en: And so they start focusing on these three things, and all of those end up coming back to the warehouses because they need space to be able to sell things and hold the inventory,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们开始专注于这三件事，而所有这些最终都回到了仓库，因为他们需要空间来销售物品并持有库存，

sentences.en: particularly when they started letting merchants sell products on their website, delivering things quickly.
sentences.zh: 特别是当他们开始允许商家在他们的网站上销售产品、快速交付物品时。

sentences.en: That's all about how fast they can fulfill the orders and get them to customers.
sentences.zh: 这完全关乎他们能以多快的速度完成订单并将之送到客户手中。

sentences.en: And then also on price, that the more efficient they become, the lower their costs.
sentences.zh: 然后还有价格，他们变得越高效，成本就越低。

sentences.en: And so they start building more and more warehouses around the country, and it starts creating this, they call it a flywheel, their kind of tech term, that the faster things come,
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始在全国建造越来越多的仓库，这开始创造出他们所谓的飞轮效应，这是他们的某种技术术语：东西送达得越快，

sentences.en: the cheaper the prices are, the bigger the variety they have, the more people buy.
sentences.zh: 价格就越便宜，种类就越多，买的人就越多。

sentences.en: And that keeps kind of spinning up and up, and people become more and more loyal to Amazon.
sentences.zh: 这种循环不断加速，人们对亚马逊的忠诚度也越来越高。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, you have a company that has become a major force, a transformative force, in the whole warehousing industry and delivery industry.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你拥有了一家在整个仓储和快递行业中成为主要力量、变革性力量的公司。

sentences.en: And they basically create it in many ways.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在很多方面基本上是创造了这个行业。

sentences.en: It's not that there aren't other e-commerce companies, but the operations become the heart of what Amazon does behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 并不是说没有其他电商公司，但运营已经成为亚马逊幕后工作的核心。

sentences.en: And they know that when you see, we can get this to you in two days, you are more likely to buy it.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，当你看到“我们能在两天内把这个送到你手上”时，你更有可能购买它。

sentences.en: They start opening warehouses closer to pretty much every major city, and all of that creates more jobs and more work because people are buying more from Amazon.
sentences.zh: 他们开始在几乎每个主要城市附近开设更多仓库，所有这些都创造了更多的岗位和工作，因为人们从亚马逊买得更多了。

sentences.en: And how exactly at this point are robots fitting into this, what sounds like a very successful push toward more and more efficiency, faster and faster delivery times?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，机器人究竟是如何融入这股听起来非常成功的、追求更高效率和更快配送速度的浪潮中的？

sentences.en: The biggest investment was in 2012.
sentences.zh: 最大的投资是在2012年。

sentences.en: They bought a company called Kiva.
sentences.zh: 他们收购了一家名为Kiva的公司。

sentences.en: And what Kiva did is do these little robots that are like a large hockey puck, and they pick up towers of inventory, and they move them to a worker.
sentences.zh: Kiva做的事情是制造这些小机器人，它们像一个大冰球，能够拿起一垛垛库存，并把它们移动到工人面前。

sentences.en: And it cut out a lot of the walking in a warehouse.
sentences.zh: 这省去了仓库里的大量步行。

sentences.en: You used to walk back and forth across all the aisles to pick the products.
sentences.zh: 过去你必须在各个过道里来回走动来拣选产品。

sentences.en: And that's annoying work for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对于很多人来说，这是件烦人的工作。

sentences.en: It's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 令人筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: And also, it's very slow and time-consuming.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也非常缓慢和耗时。

sentences.en: And so by bringing the products to the people, to the pickers, they could start getting a much higher efficiency out of the labor force.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过将产品送到人面前、送到拣货员面前，他们可以从劳动力中获得高得多的效率。

sentences.en: So at this point, early on, the effect of automation is to make this delivery process as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以在早期这个时候，自动化的效果就是让配送流程尽可能快。

sentences.en: Again, to just increase the volume of sales to help with what you call that flywheel.
sentences.zh: 同样地，为了增加销售额，以支持你所说的那个飞轮。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it works.
sentences.zh: 最终，它奏效了。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, you have a company that has become a major force, a transformative force in the whole warehousing industry and delivery industry.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你拥有了一家在整个仓储和配送行业中成为主要力量、变革性力量的公司。

sentences.en: And they basically create it in many ways.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在很多方面基本上是创造了这个行业。

sentences.en: It transforms consumer expectations, and it transforms retailing and e-commerce broadly.
sentences.zh: 它改变了消费者的期望，并广泛改变了零售业和电子商务。

sentences.en: It's the default way people come to shop is they know that Amazon can get it quickly and that Amazon will get it to them when they say they can.
sentences.zh: 人们购物的默认方式变成了：他们知道亚马逊能快速送达，并且亚马逊会在承诺的时候将商品送到他们手上。

sentences.en: It becomes very dependable, and it becomes this consumer behavior that is entwined with how so many people shop.
sentences.zh: 这变得非常可靠，并成为一种与许多人购物方式交织在一起的消费者行为。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you have Amazon adding and adding to its workforce to make that change possible.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，亚马逊不断为其劳动力队伍添砖加瓦，以使这种变革成为可能。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And even then, they were starting to get nervous about this rapid growth and also just to be able to hire enough workers.
sentences.zh: 即便在那个时候，他们也开始对这种快速增长感到紧张，同时也担心能否雇用足够的工人。

sentences.en: I mean, they were worried about having enough people in America to employ because their turnover was really high, and in some parts of the country,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们担心美国没有足够的人可供雇用，因为他们的员工流失率真的很高，在全国的一些地方，

sentences.en: they were already kind of working through the available workforce.
sentences.zh: 他们已经快要把当地可用的劳动力用光了。

sentences.en: And they were starting to face more and more pressure over the working conditions.
sentences.zh: 而且他们开始面临越来越多关于工作条件的压力。

sentences.en: You know, the work is very repetitive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这项工作非常重复。

sentences.en: You do the same thing over and over again.
sentences.zh: 你一直在做同一件事。

sentences.en: You might be reaching up very high or very low, so there was risk of strain and repetitive injuries.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要举得非常高或弯得非常低，因此存在劳损和重复性损伤的风险。

sentences.en: And they just started getting a lot of tough questions about the conditions in their warehouses.
sentences.zh: 他们开始收到大量关于其仓库工作条件的尖锐提问。

sentences.en: And then the pandemic arrives, and that just scrambles everything.
sentences.zh: 然后疫情来临，这把一切都彻底打乱了。

sentences.en: Doors start shutting down.
sentences.zh: 大门开始关闭。

sentences.en: We're all home.
sentences.zh: 我们都待在家里。

sentences.en: We're scared.
sentences.zh: 我们很害怕。

sentences.en: Our kids aren't at school, and you're buying coloring books and pop-a-shot basketball hoops.
sentences.zh: 我们的孩子不在学校，而你在买填色书和迷你投篮框。

sentences.en: These are all not hypotheticals from friends that I know.
sentences.zh: 这些都不是我认识的朋友的假设情况。

sentences.en: You know, you're doing things to not go crazy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你做这些事是为了不让自己发疯。

sentences.en: Adults are getting coloring books, you know.
sentences.zh: 成年人们都在买填色书，你知道的。

sentences.en: And everyone starts shopping online.
sentences.zh: 每个人都开始在网上购物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But they couldn't staff their warehouses fully, and so things started getting really delayed.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法让仓库人员满编，所以事情开始严重延迟。

sentences.en: Like, you would have two weeks to get an order.
sentences.zh: 比如，你得等两周才能拿到一个订单。

sentences.en: And people did start shopping elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 人们确实开始去别处购物了。

sentences.en: Like, other competitors were gaining market share because Amazon didn't have enough workers.
sentences.zh: 比如，其他竞争对手正在获得市场份额，因为亚马逊没有足够的工人。

sentences.en: And so even as some workers are staying home,
sentences.zh: 因此，即使一些工人待在家里，

sentences.en: Amazon goes on this essentially historic hiring spree.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊还是展开了这场堪称历史性的招聘狂潮。

sentences.en: They were hiring at a level that had not happened outside of, like, wartime mobilizations.
sentences.zh: 他们的招聘规模是除了战时动员之外从未发生过的。

sentences.en: I remember talking to labor economists at the time.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时和劳动经济学家交谈过。

sentences.en: So it was just this massive growth.
sentences.zh: 所以这简直是巨大的增长。

sentences.en: And by 2021, they had more than 1.1 million workers in the United States.
sentences.zh: 到2021年，他们在全美拥有超过110万名员工。

sentences.en: And some of those are absolutely corporate employees and technology employees, but the heart of that is the warehouse labor force.
sentences.zh: 其中一些绝对是公司员工和技术人员，但其中的核心是仓库劳动力。

sentences.en: And the cost of labor got very high, and they started reaching a point where they were basically not profiting because of all of this labor expense
sentences.zh: 劳动成本变得非常高，他们开始达到这样一个点：由于所有这些劳动力成本

sentences.en: and inefficiencies in their operations.
sentences.zh: 以及运营中的低效，他们基本上没有盈利。

sentences.en: Basically, this is the point where Amazon hits the wall, right?
sentences.zh: 基本上，这就是亚马逊撞南墙的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: Where very quickly, they find themselves with a much bigger workforce that not only was very costly, but actually was starting to affect their bottom line.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现自己拥有了一支庞大得多的劳动力队伍，这不仅成本高昂，而且实际上开始影响他们的利润。

sentences.en: How do they respond?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何应对的？

sentences.en: So in this period, Amazon gets a new CEO.
sentences.zh: 因此在这个时期，亚马逊迎来了新CEO。

sentences.en: Jeff Bezos becomes executive chairman, and Andy Jassy, who had run the very profitable cloud computing unit, now runs all of Amazon.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯成为执行董事长，而曾运营过利润极为丰厚的云计算部门的安迪·贾西现在掌管整个亚马逊。

sentences.en: And he starts focusing very intently on cutting costs.
sentences.zh: 他开始非常专注于削减成本。

sentences.en: And part of that was really trying to look at how can they advance automation further.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分就是真正着眼于他们如何能进一步推进自动化。

sentences.en: And the automation and robotics team sets this ambitious goal to not just augment the work that workers are doing, but to replace them.
sentences.zh: 自动化和机器人团队设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标：不仅要辅助工人们正在做的工作，还要取代他们。

sentences.en: And that plan is not hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 而且这个计划并非假设。

sentences.en: I mean, it is happening now, and it is being rolled out around the country.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它正在发生，而且正在全国范围内推行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作“拼写蜜蜂”和“字母包厢”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你们听到声音的那群人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: Karen, you said before the break that basically this plan for robots to start replacing jobs in a massive way is now being rolled out across the country.
sentences.zh: 凯伦，你在中场休息前提到，基本上这个让机器人大规模替代工作的计划现在正在全国范围内推行。

sentences.en: So what does that actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么这实际上是什么样子的呢？

sentences.en: So that looks like a warehouse in Shreveport, Louisiana that I went to a couple weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像我几周前去过的一家位于路易斯安那州什里夫波特的仓库。

sentences.en: And this is the most advanced warehouse Amazon has, and they see it as a template for future warehouses.
sentences.zh: 这是亚马逊最先进的仓库，他们将其视为未来仓库的模板。

sentences.en: Now we are going to the east side of the building.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要去大楼的东侧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And that is where we are going to see how we bring in freight into the building.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们要看货物是如何运进大楼的地方。

sentences.en: So when I got there, the head of the warehouse, the manager took me on a tour of the building.
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，仓库负责人、经理带我参观了这座建筑。

sentences.en: So we have a first floor, and then you have four floors on top.
sentences.zh: 我们有一楼，上面还有四层。

sentences.en: And it's brand new, it's bright, it's very tall, it's five stories, and you walk inside, and it's super clean.
sentences.zh: 它是崭新的、明亮的、非常高，有五层楼，你走进去，里面超级干净。

sentences.en: We have about a thousand robots in the building.
sentences.zh: 大楼里大约有一千个机器人。

sentences.en: A thousand, okay.
sentences.zh: 一千个，好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there's this loud, constant humming of the conveyor belts.
sentences.zh: 传送带发出持续而响亮的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: Turns out there's more than 13 miles of conveyor belts in that building.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，那栋大楼里有超过13英里的传送带。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But it was also kind of calm because it wasn't chaotic.
sentences.zh: 但它也显得有点平静，因为并不混乱。

sentences.en: When you have a lot of workers around, there's usually like an energy and a vibrancy about it, and there are big parts of the building that have almost no workers.
sentences.zh: 当周围有很多工人的时候，通常会有一种活力和生气，而大楼里有很大一部分区域几乎没有工人。

sentences.en: And the robots themselves are not particularly loud.
sentences.zh: 机器人本身并不是特别吵。

sentences.en: It's really just the conveyor belts that make noise.
sentences.zh: 其实只有传送带在发出噪音。

sentences.en: This is a place where we do consolidation.
sentences.zh: 这是我们进行合并整理的地方。

sentences.en: So the warehouse manager took me upstairs and led me to an area with a fleet of robots.
sentences.zh: 因此，仓库经理带我上楼，把我领到一个有成群机器人的区域。

sentences.en: They're called Sparrow.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为“麻雀”。

sentences.en: And each one is quite tall, you know, taller than me.
sentences.zh: 每一个都相当高，你知道的，比我还高。

sentences.en: It has a large yellow robotic arm that kind of bends over and reaches into bins.
sentences.zh: 它有一个巨大的黄色机械臂，会俯身并伸进箱子里。

sentences.en: The arm has suction cups on the end, and it uses different parts of the suction cup fingers, they're sort of like fingers, to pick up items and to put them in another bin,
sentences.zh: 机械臂的末端有吸盘，它利用吸盘手指的不同部位（它们有点像手指）来拾取物品并把它们放入另一个箱子中，

sentences.en: and that helps them consolidate inventory.
sentences.zh: 这有助于它们合并库存。

sentences.en: And it's pretty funny to watch because sometimes it's like, is it going to drop?
sentences.zh: 看着挺搞笑的，因为有时候你会觉得：它会掉下来吗？

sentences.en: You know, they'll pick up a T-shirt bag and it starts sagging because it's floppy, and then it does make it into the bin.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们会拿起一个T恤袋子，由于它很软开始下垂，然后它确实成功放进了箱子里。

sentences.en: And sometimes it'll be like, hey, I need help with this product, can somebody go help?
sentences.zh: 有时它会发出这样的信息：嘿，我需要这个产品的帮助，有人能来帮帮吗？

sentences.en: Sparrow just keeps doing this over and over again.
sentences.zh: “麻雀”就这样一遍又一遍地重复着。

sentences.en: They're sort of flashing lights as it takes stock of the inventory.
sentences.zh: 当它盘点库存时，会闪烁一些灯光。

sentences.en: It is using the most advanced LLM models to help us make these decisions.
sentences.zh: 它正在使用最先进的大语言模型来帮助我们做出这些决定。

sentences.en: In the tour, I could really see how all these different systems were orchestrated to work together.
sentences.zh: 在参观过程中，我真正看到了所有这些不同的系统是如何被编排在一块工作的。

sentences.en: You had different types of robotic arms, different ways to move items robotically, and then also just conveyor belts and other machines with humans kind of tapping in and out
sentences.zh: 你有不同类型的机械臂、以机器人方式移动物品的不同方法，还有传送带和其他机器，人类在

sentences.en: at different points.
sentences.zh: 不同的节点上进行人工介入。

sentences.en: The way the products moved through the building was a whole new way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 产品在建筑物中移动的方式是一种全新的思维方式。

sentences.en: They had completely rethought the way everything operated in the warehouse with this eye to introducing as much automation as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们带着引入尽可能多的自动化的愿景，完全重新构思了仓库中一切运作的方式。

sentences.en: So this all sounds incredibly futuristic.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切听起来极具未来感。

sentences.en: I can hear in your voice how impressive and kind of astounding it was for you.
sentences.zh: 从你的声音中我能听出这对你来说是多么震撼和令人惊叹。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What will it look like for Amazon to scale up this approach across several warehouses?
sentences.zh: 亚马逊在多个仓库中扩大这种方法的应用会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Yes, the automation team said that that facility
sentences.zh: 是的，自动化团队表示，该设施

sentences.en: confidence that they'll be able to, quote, flatten Amazon's hiring curve in the next 10 years.
sentences.zh: 充满信心，他们将能够在未来10年内“拉平亚马逊的招聘曲线”。

sentences.en: Flatten Amazon's hiring curve is corporate speak for stop hiring, right?
sentences.zh: “拉平亚马逊的招聘曲线”是企业黑话，意思是停止招聘，对吧？

sentences.en: Stop hiring.
sentences.zh: 停止招聘。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Even as they expect their business to double, they would need the same number of employees as today.
sentences.zh: 即便他们预计业务会翻倍，他们需要的员工数量仍将与今天相同。

sentences.en: And so that will mean they're both going to build new warehouses, starting with this as the baseline, and that they're also going to retrofit older warehouses so that they'll need
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们既要以这为基准建造新的仓库，也要改造旧仓库，以便他们需要

sentences.en: fewer workers to do the same or more work.
sentences.zh: 更少的工人来完成相同或更多的工作。

sentences.en: They're starting with one in Stone Mountain, Georgia, near Atlanta right now.
sentences.zh: 他们目前正从亚特兰大附近的佐治亚州斯通芒特的一家仓库开始着手。

sentences.en: And that's a more sensitive thing because there you're taking a building that used to have
sentences.zh: 这是一个更敏感的问题，因为在那里你接手的是一栋曾经拥有

sentences.en: 4,000 employees, and when you introduce the robotics, they potentially will need
sentences.zh: 4000名员工的建筑，而当你引入机器人技术时，一旦完工，他们可能需要

sentences.en: 1,200 fewer workers once they're done.
sentences.zh: 减少1200名工人。

sentences.en: And Amazon says those numbers are tentative, nothing's final, but the reason you do this is to reduce your need for labor.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊表示，这些数字是暂时的，还没有最终确定，但你这样做的原因是为了减少对劳动力的需求。

sentences.en: You're saying
sentences.zh: 你是说

sentences.en: Amazon is going to need far fewer people maintaining robots than it's going to need packers, pickers on the warehouse floor.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊未来维护机器人所需的人数将远远少于其在仓库车间所需的打包工和分拣工。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, yeah.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，是的。

sentences.en: I should note that
sentences.zh: 我应该指出的是

sentences.en: Amazon isn't disputing this reporting.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊并未对这篇报道提出异议。

sentences.en: There's kind of two main things they have to say.
sentences.zh: 他们大概要表达两点主要内容。

sentences.en: One is that they say the goals of the automation team don't represent all of the goals of the company.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们表示自动化团队的目标并不代表公司的全部目标。

sentences.en: And so while, yes, they may be focusing on efficiency here, there might be other parts of the business, including in their warehousing operation, that they might grow
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然他们在这里可能专注于效率，但业务的其他部分（包括仓储业务）可能会随着

sentences.en: as they make more investments in the future.
sentences.zh: 未来更多投资而增长。

sentences.en: And an example they pointed to is they've been building more delivery stations in areas that are more remote and have a smaller population.
sentences.zh: 他们举的一个例子是，他们一直在较为偏远、人口较少的地区建造更多的配送站。

sentences.en: And so those are new jobs in places that didn't have them and letting customers in more rural areas get faster deliveries.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些是在原本没有这些设施的地方创造的新工作岗位，并让偏远地区的客户能够获得更快的配送。

sentences.en: The other thing they say is that they're very focused on the new jobs that are being created because of automation and robotics.
sentences.zh: 他们要说的另一件事是，他们非常关注因自动化和机器人技术而创造的新工作岗位。

sentences.en: And there's a type of role that's essentially a technician or a mechanic that works with the robots.
sentences.zh: 有一类职位本质上是与机器人一起工作的技术员或机械师。

sentences.en: And they do everything from maintenance, they do repairs, they handle what are called exceptions, like if the robot drops something, they are able to safely go and to deal
sentences.zh: 他们负责一切工作，从维护、修理到处理所谓的异常情况（比如如果机器人掉落了什么东西），他们能够安全地前往处理

sentences.en: with all that.
sentences.zh: 所有这些问题。

sentences.en: And so those jobs pay more and they have more of a career path than a traditional
sentences.zh: 因此，这些工作的薪水更高，而且比传统的

sentences.en: Amazon warehouse job does.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊仓库工作拥有更好的职业发展路径。

sentences.en: The main issue is that there just aren't as many of them when you compare it to the number of regular hourly worker jobs that won't be needed.
sentences.zh: 主要问题是，与不需要的常规按小时计酬的工人岗位相比，这类岗位的数量实在不够多。

sentences.en: But it's worth considering some of the business realities, at least as Amazon sees them, right?
sentences.zh: 但至少从亚马逊的角度来看，考虑一些商业现实是值得的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, this company wants to keep growing, to keep beating its competitors, and in the past, the way that it's done that is by hiring a ton of people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这家公司希望继续增长、击败竞争对手，而在过去，它实现这一点的方式就是雇佣大量的人。

sentences.en: And after a certain point, the company has found that just doesn't work, it becomes really difficult and expensive.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时间点之后，公司发现这根本行不通，变得非常困难且昂贵。

sentences.en: So if Amazon wants to keep growing and keep its customers happy, this is a company that's attempting to solve the very real problems in its model.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果亚马逊想要继续发展并让客户满意，这家公司就是在试图解决其模式中非常现实的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, they see this as essential for being competitive in the retail environment with endlessly demanding consumers.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他们认为这对于在面对要求永无止境的消费者时保持零售环境的竞争力至关重要。

sentences.en: And some of the projections I saw in a few years, it'll save 30 cents per item, which is actually kind of a lot.
sentences.zh: 我看到的一些预测显示，几年后，每件商品将节省30美分，这其实是一笔不小的数目。

sentences.en: And then they can use that 30 cents to lower costs or to invest in new things.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可以用这30美分来降低成本或投资新项目。

sentences.en: And at its core,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，

sentences.en: Amazon's reason for being isn't to be an employer.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊存在的理由不是为了成为一个雇主。

sentences.en: It's a customer-centric company,
sentences.zh: 它是一家以客户为中心的公司，

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: Amazon is the most advanced in this kind of push towards automation, but their competitors are working on it too.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊在这种推动自动化的浪潮中最先进，但他们的竞争对手也在努力。

sentences.en: Walmart,
sentences.zh: 沃尔玛、

sentences.en: UPS,
sentences.zh: 联合包裹（UPS）、

sentences.en: DHL, all these companies are investing in automation.
sentences.zh: 敦豪（DHL），所有这些公司都在投资自动化。

sentences.en: And so this allows them to stay competitive and to keep offering the faster service, the more products, the cheaper prices that we talked about that customers consistently love.
sentences.zh: 因此，这使他们能够保持竞争力，并继续提供我们所讨论的、客户一直喜爱的更快服务、更多产品和更低价格。

sentences.en: In other words, this automation is coming, not just at Amazon, but likely much more broadly.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这种自动化即将来临，不仅在亚马逊，而且很可能会在更广泛的范围内普及。

sentences.en: It just makes too much good business sense to not do.
sentences.zh: 不做这件事在商业上实在说不通。

sentences.en: And so I guess,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，

sentences.en: Karen, that raises this really pressing question, right, which is, what does a much more automated workforce ultimately look like?
sentences.zh: 凯伦，这就引发了一个非常紧迫的问题，对吧？也就是：高度自动化的劳动力队伍最终会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What is the balance of jobs?
sentences.zh: 工作的平衡点在哪里？

sentences.en: And what does that actually mean for people who are doing those jobs today?
sentences.zh: 这对今天正在做这些工作的人来说到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, you run the risk of kind of this bifurcation where you lose more of the baseline hourly work and you gain more higher-skilled, higher-paid work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你面临着一种两极分化的风险：你失去了更多基层的按小时计酬工作，却获得了更多高技能、高薪的工作。

sentences.en: I mean, in theory, automation is supposed to get rid of the bad and the mundane, the boring parts of the job, but it's unclear how those numbers balance out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从理论上讲，自动化应该消除工作中糟糕、平庸和枯燥的部分，但这些数字将如何平衡尚不清楚。

sentences.en: You know, in this case, so far, we're seeing not as many of those higher-skilled jobs as there would be of the hourly work.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在这种情况下，到目前为止，我们看到的那些高技能工作并没有按小时计酬的工作那么多。

sentences.en: It's also not clear if they're the same people that can do them.
sentences.zh: 目前也不清楚它们是否能由同一群人来胜任。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: Amazon has this apprentice program.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊有这样一个学徒项目。

sentences.en: They say 5,000 people have gone through it, but you do have more requirements going into it and you need to go through training.
sentences.zh: 他们说已有5000人通过了该项目，但参与其中确实有更多要求，你需要接受培训。

sentences.en: So, I mean, they're worried about having enough people who can do that work, but it's not necessarily the same person that might come in and find a typical
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，他们担心是否有足够的人能够胜任这些工作，但这不一定是那些可能进来寻找传统

sentences.en: Amazon job because you don't need great English skills, because you don't need to come in with much beyond a clean drug test and being over 18.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊工作的人，因为你不需要出色的英语技能，因为你除了干净的药检证明和年满18岁之外，不需要具备太多条件。

sentences.en: You know, to step back, it's probably worth noting that your reporting is coming at a moment when the job numbers across the board in the United States are not as strong
sentences.zh: 退一步讲，可能值得注意的是，你的报道发布之际，美国整体的就业数字并不像以前那样强劲

sentences.en: as they once were.
sentences.zh: 了。

sentences.en: And when you add that picture to what you found, it sounds like the outlook feels a little gloomier.
sentences.zh: 当你把这幅图景和你发现的情况结合起来时，前景听起来似乎有点黯淡。

sentences.en: I think that's right because when you have a tough economy, companies look for more efficiencies and so it creates more pressure to do exactly this type of thing
sentences.zh: 我认为这是对的，因为当经济不景气时，公司会寻找更多的效率提升途径，因此无论工作岗位如何，

sentences.en: regardless of the jobs.
sentences.zh: 这都会产生更大的压力去准确做这种事情。

sentences.en: And obviously, even though
sentences.zh: 显然，尽管

sentences.en: Amazon warehouse jobs may not be necessarily the best jobs in the world, they're all jobs.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊的仓库工作可能不一定是世界上最好的工作，但它们终究是工作。

sentences.en: And for the people who need them to not have them, to not have that opportunity, there is a cost there.
sentences.zh: 对于那些需要它们却失去它们、失去这个机会的人来说，是有代价的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The Amazon jobs are known for being there and accessible in many ways.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊的工作在许多方面以容易获取而闻名。

sentences.en: You know, they pay above minimum wage, they have health care, they have parental leave, they compete with other local employers for workers.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们的薪水高于最低工资，有医疗保健，有产假，它们在争夺工人的过程中与当地其他雇主竞争。

sentences.en: And so when you remove or over time kind of decrease the pressure they have on the overall local labor market, it can have an impact more broadly.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你取消或随着时间推移逐渐减轻它们对整体地方劳动力市场的压力时，它可能会产生更广泛的影响。

sentences.en: Amazon knows that this is extremely sensitive and kind of radioactive in the communities where they operate.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊知道这极其敏感，在他们运营的社区里犹如“放射性物质”般危险。

sentences.en: And I saw a bunch of documents that show us that they are actively debating how to manage this, how to communicate with their own workers, how to communicate with elected officials
sentences.zh: 我看到了一堆文件，向我们展示他们正在积极辩论如何管理这一点，如何与自己的工人沟通，如何与民选官员

sentences.en: and other community members.
sentences.zh: 和其他社区成员沟通。

sentences.en: They've debated avoiding words like robot and instead using the term cobot, which implies collaboration with people.
sentences.zh: 他们曾讨论过避免使用“机器人”一词，而改用“协作机器人”一词，这意味着与人合作。

sentences.en: They've talked about avoiding the word artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他们讨论过避免使用“人工智能”一词，

sentences.en: and they know that this is a scary concept because Amazon is a signature employer in the places where they operate and in our country.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这是一个可怕的概念，因为亚马逊是他们运营所在地以及我们国家的标志性雇主。

sentences.en: Other people look to them for what the future of work will be.
sentences.zh: 其他人都在看着他们，以了解未来工作的样貌。

sentences.en: And our nation as a whole is not good at helping people adjust through these transformations in the workforce.
sentences.zh: 而我们整个国家并不擅长在劳动力经历这些转型时帮助人们适应。

sentences.en: We don't have a great way of making sure the people who otherwise may have been hired have other job opportunities or have the job training to be able to do the new jobs
sentences.zh: 我们没有一个好方法来确保那些本来会被雇用的人拥有其他就业机会，或者拥有能够胜任自动化未来的新工作的

sentences.en: that come out of a more automated future.
sentences.zh: 职业培训。

sentences.en: And so that is where the tension is, is, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是矛盾所在，你知道的，

sentences.en: Amazon is moving forward.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊正在向前迈进。

sentences.en: It makes sense for them to try to save this money here and be able to do other things with those savings.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里试图省下这笔钱并能够利用这些节省下来的资金去做别的事情，这是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: But they do have this outsized impact on society and in the labor market.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实对社会和劳动力市场产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: And the reality is there's not a frank conversation about automation.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，并没有关于自动化的坦诚对话。

sentences.en: And there's no one with an overarching plan of how to help people adapt.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何人制定如何帮助人们适应的总体规划。

sentences.en: Well, Karen, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，凯伦，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
